    def _fk_frames(self, q, frames) -> dict:
        """World poses [x, y, z, qw, qx, qy, qz] of `frames` for joint positions q (7) from the kinematic model; no simulator state."""

def curve(p,spacing=.7):
    qs=[];ts=[]
    for k in range(len(p)-1):
        a,b,c,d=p[max(0,k-1)],p[k],p[k+1],p[min(len(p)-1,k+2)]
        n=max(3,int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(c[:2]-b[:2])*4)))
        t=np.arange(n)/n
        A=2*b;B=-a+c;C=2*a-5*b+4*c-d;D=-a+3*b-3*c+d
        q=.5*(A[None]+B[None]*t[:,None]+C[None]*t[:,None]**2+D[None]*t[:,None]**3)
        v=.5*(B[None]+2*C[None]*t[:,None]+3*D[None]*t[:,None]**2)
        qs.extend(q);ts.extend(v[:,:2])
    qs.append(p[-1]);ts.append(p[-1,:2]-p[-2,:2])
    q=np.array(qs);v=np.array(ts);u=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(q[:,:2],axis=0),axis=1))]
    samples=np.linspace(0,u[-1],int(np.ceil(u[-1]/spacing))+1)
    q=np.array([np.interp(samples,u,q[:,j]) for j in range(3)]).T
    v=np.array([np.interp(samples,u,v[:,j]) for j in range(2)]).T;v/=np.linalg.norm(v,axis=1)[:,None]
    q[:,2]=np.maximum(.2,q[:,2]);return q,v

def plan(p,brush,geo,speed=.004):
